<description>
`/rest/spenttxouts/<hash>` reads the undo file for every block above genesis. For a block that was stored but never connected (a side branch) or whose undo data was pruned, there is no undo position, so `OpenUndoFile()` fails and `ReadBlockUndo()` writes `OpenUndoFile failed for FlatFilePos(nFile=-1, nPos=0)` to debug.log with `LogError`. The request itself already returns 404, but each unauthenticated request for such a block adds an `[error]` line that looks like disk corruption.

This checks `CheckBlockDataAvailability()` for `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO` before reading, so nothing is logged. Pruning clears `BLOCK_HAVE_UNDO`, so pruned blocks are covered too. The response is unchanged.

The new check at the end of `interface_rest.py` requests a stale block and fails on master because of the logged error.
</description>
